The wind noticeably catches her light-colored coat, adding a sense of motion and outdoor atmosphere to the sequence. (6) The video concludes with a medium close-up of the woman, who is now wearing a red knitted cardigan, a matching red beanie, and red-rimmed glasses. She turns her head to look directly into the lens and smiles warmly. The white church with its red steeple is visible in the background, though it is slightly blurred due to the shallow depth of field, emphasizing her joyful reaction.
